key_concepts: Forces can be contact or non-contact
Non-contact forces act between objects not physically touching
Non-contact forces are also called action-at-a-distance
Non-contact forces act within a force field
Gravitational force is the attraction between the Sun and Earth
Gravity attracts objects on Earth toward the ground
Electrostatic force is exerted by a charged body on another charged or uncharged body
Opposite charges attract while similar charges repel
Magnetic force is exerted by a magnet on some metals and other magnets
Removing a supporting surface allows gravity to pull an object down
